s: Dine bediqat hechametz ubo m"g seipim: habbediqa tzarik shettihyeh leor hanner, velo leor hallebana, velo leor hachamma, kegon im abar velo badaq belel y"d vechayyab hu libdoq beyom y"d kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tl"h, lo yibdoq leor hachamma ella leor hanner, sheor hanner yapeh libdiqa vechippus bammachaboot bachorim ubassedaqim:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Becheder meqoreh sheyyesh lo d' mechitzot veen or hachamma niknas letoko ella derek chorim vechallonot, abal cheder sheen lo ella g' mechitztzot, ap al pi shehu meqoreh vehu hanniqra aksadra, kevan sheoro rab meod — yakol lebodqo lekattechilla bayyom belo or hanner apillu bayyom hamunnan:

Vaapillu cheder sheyyesh lo d' mechitzot, im yesh sham arubba begaggo (perush, sheggaggotehen hayu shavin velo haya alehem od gag acher meshuppa millemala) vaarubba zo hi petucha legamre, sheen bah mechitztza shel zekukit — muttar libdoq beqarqait hacheder shekkeneged haarubba bayyom belo or hanner apillu hu yom hamunnan, abal shear qarqait hacheder sheenah keneged haarubba mammash tzarik libdoq leor hanner:
Veken challon shebbakkotel, im en bah mechitztza shel zekukit, kol mah shemmekuvvan kenegdo mammash en tzarik bediqa leor hanner im hu bodeq bayyom apillu hu yom hamunnan:

Vekol zeh kesheabar o shakach velo badaq belel y"d, abal lekattechilla apillu aksadra veshekkeneged arubba vechallon en libdoq ki im belel y"d leor hanner. Vaapillu im rotzeh lehaqdim ulebodqam beyom y"g leor hachamma — eno rashshay, shemmebattel hu taqqanat chakamim shettiqqenu libdoq ballayla beshaa shebbene adam metzuyin bebattehem. Umikkol maqom im abar ubadaq et haaksadra beyom y"g o bishar yemot hashshana venizhar shello lehaknis sham od chametz — yatza, veen tzarik lachazor ulebodqah belel y"d leor hanner:

Abal shear kol hachadarim sheyyesh bahem d' mechitztzot, im abar ubedaqan beyom y"g leor hanner — tzarik lachazor ulebodqan belel y"d, lepi sheen or hanner mabhiq yapeh bayyom. Vaapillu im badaq cheder apel beyom y"g leor hanner shehachoshek betoko shaveh bayyom uballayla, ap al pi ken tzarik lachazor ulebodqo belel y"d, lepi sheen habhaqat hanner bayyom apillu becheder apel domeh lehabhaqato ballayla:

Abal im rotzeh libdoq kol chadarayv belel y"g o bishar lelot hashshana leor hanner ulehizzaher shello lehaknis lesham od chametz — hareshut beyado, raq shello yebarek al bediqa zo, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tl"v. Lepikak, nakon haddabar sheyyeshayyer cheder echad lebodqo belel y"d ulebarek al bediqato, shello lehapsid beraka bayyadayim. Umikkol maqom ap im badaq kol chadarayv velo shiyyer kelum — tzarik hu lachazor velibdoq paam acheret lo pachot cheder echad belel y"d, kevan shebbelayla zeh chal chiyyub habbediqa al kol yisrael shello badequ adayin — chal hachiyyub gam al zeh shebbadaq kebar, shello lechalleq beno uben kol yisrael. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim sheen tzarik lachazor velibdoq kelum belel y"d, kevan shekkebar badaq kol chadarayv kedinam ballayla leor hanner. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem shello lebarek keshechozer ubodeq cheder echad belel y"d:

En bodeqin leor haabuqa, ella leor ner qatan yechidi, lepi sheor haabuqa en yakol lehakniso lechorim usedaqim, vegam hu mityare shello yisrop bo habbayit, vihe libbo tarud beyira zo velo yibdoq yapeh. Ulekattechilla yesh lehizzaher shello libdoq ki im bener shel shaava, abal lo bener shel cheleb, lepi shehu mityare shello yattip mimmennu al kelim kesherim, velo bener shel shumman, lepi shemmityare shello yattip mimmennu al kele chalab, velo bener shel shemen, lepi shemmityare shello yattip mimmennu al habbegadim vitannepem, vegam eno yakol lehakniso yapeh lachorim velassedaqim. Abal bediabad shekkebar badaq (b) beechad minnerot hallalu yatza, veen tzarik lachazor velibdoq bener shel shaava. Veken im hu sheat haddechaq sheen lo ner shel shaava — hare zeh kediabad, veyibdoq lekattechilla benerot acherot. Umikkol maqom im epshar lo bener shel shumman lo yibdoq beshel cheleb, shekkeshehu bodeq beshel shumman eno mityare raq shello yattip al kele chalab abal lo al kele basar, mah sheen ken beshel cheleb. Veim en lo shel shumman veyesh lo shel cheleb — yibdoq bo velo yibdoq beshel shemen, sheeno yakol lehakniso yapeh lachorim velassedaqim kemo shel cheleb:
Im abar ubadaq leor haabuqa — lo yatza, vetzarik lachazor velibdoq leor hanner. Veyesh mi sheomer sheen tzarik lachazor velibdoq. Veyesh lachosh lidbarayv shello lebarek keshechozer ubodeq:

Ner shel shemen sheddoleqin betoko b' petilot — dino kaabuqa, sheapillu abar ubadaq bo tzarik lachazor velibdoq. Veken im hidliq b' nerot shel shaava usemakan zo lezo ubadaq bahen — lo olta lo bediqa. Vaapillu qelaan yachad vaasaan keen ner echad (o sheddibbeq vechibber zo lezo ad shennaasu ner echad), mikkol maqom kevan sheyyesh kan b' petilot doleqot — hare zo abuqa:

En bodeqin leor haetzim, shehaetz eno doleq yapeh keshehu yechidi. Ushene etzim apillu hem daqqim meod — dinam kaabuqa. Vaapillu min etz sheddoleq yechidi sheqqorin (bilshon ashkenaz qy"n) — en libdoq bo lekattechilla (im yesh lo ner shel shaava), dekevan sherecho ra, vegam nitzotzot menattezin mimmennu kesheddoleq, yesh lachosh sheal yede ken lo yibdoq heteb:

Kebar nitbaer besiman tl"a shemmin hattora keshemmebattel et hechametz umapqiro qodem zeman issuro — dayyo. Veim eno rotzeh lebattelo ulehapqiro — chayyab hu libdoq ulechappes acharayv min hattora kesheyyaggia zeman issuro ulebaaro min haolam legamre. Ukeshehu oseh kak, im betok happesach matza kezayit chametz bebeto shello matza bibdiqato — lo abar alayv lemaprea be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", shehare anus hu, kevan shebbadaq kedino. Veeno chayyab libdoq min hattora ella bimqomot sheragil lehishtammesh bahen chametz kol hashshana bitdirut, kegon habbayit vachadarayv sheragil leekol bahen chametz kol hashshana, vei epshar shello nitparer venapal sham perur chametz sheyyesh bo kezayit, veober alayv be"bal yimmatze" min hattora ap al pi sheeno nireh lo (ayyen siman t"m) kol yeme happesach. Abal shear hachadarim sheeno ragil lehishtammesh bahen chametz bitdirut veqarob haddabar shello nishtayyer bahen chametz kezayit — en tzarik lebodqan min hattora ap al pi shello bittel:

Abal middibre soperim ap al pi shebbittel kol chametzo — chayyab hu libdoq ulechappes acharayv bekol hammeqomot sheyyesh lachosh ulehistappeq shemma hiknis lesham chametz beaqray. Lepikak, kol chadre habbayit vehaaliyyot, apillu otan shebbari lo shello akal bahen chametz meolam — hare hem tzerikim bediqa kedinah ballayla leor hanner, lepi shellipamim adam qam mittok seudato upitto beyado veniknas lachadarayv lehishtammesh bahen tashmishayv, kegon chadar hammashk[o]not shellipamim niknas letoko beemtza hasseuda lehotzi mishsham mashkon lehachaziro libalayv, veyesh lachosh shemma shakach sham et pitto o shemma nitparer mimmennu shum perur chametz:

Abal otan chadarim sheen derek haadam likkanes bahen betok hasseuda, kegon otzerot yayin veshekar, sheen mistappeq mehen lishtotan o limkor mehen, veken bet hatteben — en tzerikim bediqa, ella im ken yadua lo shehiknis lesham chametz paam achat:

Abal otzerot yayin veshekar shemmistappeq mehen — tzerikin bediqa, shellipamim beemtza hasseuda hem kalim al hashshulchan veholek hashshammash lehabi mehen upitto beyado. Veken hachadarim shemmesimin bahem melach o gebinot o mine kebushim o nerot — hare hem tzerikim bediqa, shellipamim hem kalim beemtza hasseuda veholek hashshammash lehabi mehen upitto beyado:

Abal otan chadarim shemmesimin debarim sheyyesh qeba lesippuqan, dehaynu shehashshammash yodea qodem hasseuda kamma tzerikin lisuda zo veholek umebi veen tzarik lehabi od beemtza hasseuda, kegon otzarot shel shemen, vekayyotze bo debarim sheen regilin bahen tadir, veen derek limmalek ulehabian od al hashshulchan beemtza hasseuda — en tzarik bediqa. Veim hu maqom shergilin lehadliq bo nerot shel shemen — tzarik bediqa im derek lehistappeq mimmennu lenerot:

Chorim shebbekotel habbayit, veken zizim habboletim mehakketalim, im enan gebohim yoter midday velo nemukim yoter midday — hare hen tzerikin bediqa, lepi shedderek lehishtammesh bahen (abal chorim qetannim meod, veken hassedaqim qetannim shebbakkotalim sheen reuyin leshum tashmish, enam tzerikim bediqa), veyesh lachosh leshemma nishtammesh bahen chametz venishar munnach sham perure chametz. Abal im gebohim kol kak ad sheen yad adam maggaat lesham, veken im hem nemukim lematta mig' tepachim samuk leqarqa habbayit — enam tzerikim bediqa, shemmin hassetam lo nishtammeshu bo. Abal im yadua lo shennishtammesh bahen chametz apillu paam achat — hare hen tzerikin bediqa. Ubebayit shehattinoqot metzuyin bo, apillu hannemukim mig' tepachim tzerikin bediqa, shemma hitzniu sham hattinoqot meat chametz:
Vekol zeh bachorim shebbakketalim, abal hachorim usedaqim shebbaqqarqait habbayit tzerikin bediqa ap al pi sheen tinoqot metzuyin sham, sheyyesh lachosh shemma napal venitgalgel lesham meat chametz:

Veim qarqait habbayit hi merutztzepet binsarim veyesh benehem chorim qetannim amuqqim veen yakol lehaknis et yado letok hachor libdoq — en tzarik leqaaqea et hannesarim libdoq tachtehem. Vaapillu im raa shennapal chametz lechor zeh haqqatan, veim lo yotziennu mishsham yihyeh munnach sham kol yeme happesach — ap al pi ken en matrichin oto lehotzio mishsham, ella mebattelo vedayyo, shehare iqqar taqqanat bediqat hechametz achar shebbittelo enah ella mishshum gezera shemma yabo leoklo bepesach, vezeh hechametz shehu munnach bemaqom sheeno yakol lehaknis yado letoko — bevadday lo yoklennu bepesach:

Veken haddin bechor shehu rachab veyakol lehaknis yadayv letoko ella shehu amoq meod veen yad adam maggaat libdoq bekullo, ben shehachor hu bekotle habbayit, ben shehu beqarqaito — hare hu bodeq betoko ad maqom sheyyado maggaat, vehashshear day lo bebittul apillu yesh sham vadday chametz, ayyen sop siman tl"ch:

Kotel ab meod shehu mechitztza ben shene battim shel shene bene adam vehachor ober betoko meeber el eber — zeh bodeq mitztzad zeh ad maqom sheyyado maggaat, vezeh bodeq mitztzad zeh ad maqom sheyyado maggaat. Ushear orek hachor shebbeemtza hakkotel, yesh lachosh shemma nitgalgel letoko chametz mitztzad zeh, veshemma nitgalgel letoko chametz mitztzad zeh, lepikak shenehem chayyabim lebattel kol chametz sheyyesh bo apillu enan yodeim beberur sheyyesh sham chametz:

Veim zeh hakkotel hu mechitztza ben beto shel yisrael lebeto shel nokri — lo yibdoq hayyisrael kelal et chore hakkotel haoberim betoko meeber el eber. Vaapillu im yesh sham chametz vadday betoko — en tzarik libdoq ulehotzio mishsham belel y"d, mippene chashash sakkana, shekkesheyyireh hannokri et hayyisrael shehu memashmesh bachor leor hanner, yomar "keshapim hu oseh li". Umikkol maqom lemachar beyom y"d yibdoq bo leor hayyom ad maqom sheyyado maggaat apillu en sham chametz vadday, shekkeshemmemashmesh bo leor hayyom — en kan chashash sakkana, shehare kak haya mishtammesh bo kol yemot hashshana leor hayyom (shekkol chor sheen derek lehishtammesh bo kelum — en tzarik bediqa kelal, kemo shennitbaer lemala), vehashshear day lo bebittul apillu yesh sham vadday chametz:

Gag hamshuppa kemo gaggot shellanu — en tzarik bediqa, mippene sheeno rauy leshum tashmish. (Abal gag hashshaveh shettachat gag hamshuppa, im derek lehishtammesh — tzarik bediqa, ella im ken hu meyuchad letashmish sheen derek lehishtammesh bo beemtza hasseuda, kegon sheasao otzar leyayin o shekar, veeno mistappeq mimmennu kelal lo lishtot velo limkor, vekol kayyotze bazeh, kemo shennitbaer lemala). Vaapillu gag meshuppa shehu namuk meod, vaapillu hu omed betok habbayit, kegon gag hammigdal (perush, kegon alma"r o shap"a bilshon ashkenaz, umatzniim betoko kelim vookalim) — en tzarik bediqa. Abal tok hammigdal, veken tok hattebot, tzerikim bediqa, shehu mishtammesh bahem chametz lipamim:

Repet shel baqar en tzarik bediqa, shekkol chametz shennapal shamma yesh litlot shehabbehemot akaluhu, vahare yesh kan sepeq sepeqa, shemma lo haya sham chametz meolam, veim timtza lomar haya, shemma akaluhu habbehemot, usepeq akilat habbehemot motzi mide sepeq chametz:

Veken lul shel tarnegolim en tzarik bediqa, shekkol chametz shehaya sham yesh litlot shehattarnegolim akaluhu. (H) veken bayit shehattarnegolim metzuyin bo en tzarik bediqa beqarqaito. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshessamuk lappesach, dehaynu kol sheloshim yom lipne happesach, nizhar shello leekol chametz betok zeh habbayit, abal im lo nizhar milleekol betoko chametz betok sheloshim yom lipne happesach — hare qarqaito tzarik bediqa kedinah ballayla leor hanner, dekevan sheakelu sham chametz i epshar shello napal sham chametz al haqqarqa, vahare yesh kan vadday chametz, vesapeq akaluhu hattarnegolim, vesapeq lo akaluhu, veen sapeq motzi mide vadday. (V) abal kol chametz shennapal letoko zeman rab qodem pesach, dehaynu qodem l' yom, yesh bo shene sepeqot lehaqel, shemma akaluhu (veshemma lo hiknisu lesham chametz), veim timtza lomar shello akaluhu hattarnegolim, shemma nitappesh beorek hazzeman o nimas ad shennipsal meakilat keleb, veen tzarik lebaaro kelal kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"b*[veap al pi shechayyab adam libdoq bekol hachadarim sheyyesh lachosh bahem leshemma hiknisu lesham chametz paam achat, ap sheyyesh kamma sepeqot lehaqel, shemma lo hiknisu sham chametz meolam, veim timtza lomar hiknisu, shemma chazeru unetaluhu kullo mishsham velo nishtayyer mimmennu sham kelum, veim timtza lomar nishtayyer mimmennu meat, shemma haya zeman rab qodem happesach venitappesh beorek hazzeman o nimas ad shennipsal meakilat keleb — haynu lepi sheiqqar taqqanat chakamim shettiqqenu libdoq ulechappes achar hechametz enah ella al hassapeq, shemma yesh sham chametz, umin hattora en lachosh kelal lesapeq kazeh, shekkelal gadol battora "en machaziqin reuta", kammeboar beyoreh dea siman l"t, ella shechakamim mechamat chomer issur hechametz hechemiru lachosh ap lesapeq kazeh, velaken hitqinu mitzvat habbediqa, veim ken mah li sapeq echad umah li kamma sepeqot. Abal sapeq haragil meod, shergilut hi shehattarnegolim vekayyotze bahen okelin kol mah shemmotzein vehu qarob levadday, ella shessapeq zeh bilbad eno yakol lehotzio mide vadday gamur, dehaynu chezqat chametz shehaya sham, shevvadday gamur adip miqqarob levadday, abal im yesh lehistappeq od sapeq acher, dehaynu shemma nipsal meakilat keleb beorek hazzeman, ap al pi shessapeq zeh eno qarob levadday, mikkol maqom al yede sapeq zeh hura kocho shel havvadday gamur, dekevan sheyyesh lehistappeq sapeq acher — hare eno vadday gamur, veeno ella keqarob levadday sheyyesh kan chametz, veyukal sapeq shel akilat tarnegolim shehi qarob levadday lehotzi mide qarob levadday. Veayyen besiman tm"d sheapillu bayit hatztzarik bediqa beqarqaito, en tzarik libdoq ulechappes ella achar perurin gedolim qetzat, abal perurim haddaqqin apillu roeh otam munnachim al gabbayv — en tzarik lehagbiham ulebaaram im hem munnachim bimqom derisat ragle bene adam, shemmealehem hem mitbaarim al yede derisat haraglayim, ella im ken roeh otam munnachim sham leachar shehiggia shaa shishshit, sheaz hu chayyab lebaaram min haolam miyyad sheyyirem ayyen sham]:.

Veken haddin bekol hachadarim sheen tzarik bediqa kelal mechamat sheen derek lehaknis bahen chametz meolam veraa qodem sheloshim yom shehiknis akbar bahem chatikot chametz — en tzarik lebodqan belel y"d mittaam shennitbaer. Abal im raa tok sheloshim yom tzarik lebodqan belel y"d, veal derek sheyyitbaer besiman tl"ch, veayyen besiman ts"h:

Veken repet shel baqar velul shel tarnegolim, im yadua lo shehaya bahem vadday chametz betok l' yom lipne happesach, ella sheeno yodea hekan hu munnach sham, hu chayyab libdoq ulechappes bahem et hechametz belel y"d leor hanner ulehotzio mishsham. Veim hu rotzeh litten lipne habbehemot vetarnegolim leekol zeh hechametz o chametz acher — tzarik hu laamod alehem ad sheyyigmeru leekol, uleayyen alehem shello yidchapu vigalgelu min hechametz kelum lemaqom acher tzanua sheeno nireh, shemma yehe munnach sham ad kenisat happesach veyaabor alayv be"bal yimmatze". Veim nishtayyer meat chametz meakilatam — yittelennu mishsham velo yanniach lipnehem, shemma yishshaer munnach sham ad kenisat happesach. Vaapillu im dato lelek alehem keshettaggia shaa shishshit velirot im munnach sham meat chametz sheyyebaarennu, mikkol maqom yesh lachosh shemma keshettaggia sheat habbiur chametz yishkach al hechametz shennatan lipnehem, lepi shello yaaleh al dato az lachosh shemma nishtayyer meat chametz meakilatam, lepikak tzarik hu beshaa shehu noten lipnehem leekol shello lazuz mehem ad sheyyigmeru leekol, veyatznia hamshuyyar kederek sheyyitbaer besiman tl"d, sheaz bevadday lo yishkach lebaaro bishat habbiur, kemo sheen shokeach lebaer kol chametz hayyadua lo:

Qarqait hechatzer en tzarik bediqa, lepi sheorebin ushear opot metzuyin sham, vehem okelim kol chametz shennopel. Vaapillu im yadua lo sheyyesh sham bechatzer vadday chametz — en tzarik littelo mishsham bishat bediqat lel y"d. Vaapillu lekattechilla yakol lehashlik chametz lechatzer qodem shettaggia shaa shishshit, ukeshettaggia shaa shishshit yelek lirot hechametz bechatzer, veim adayin hu munnach sham shello akaluhu haorebim — chayyab lebaaro min haolam legamre miyyad sheyyirennu, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"h. Veen chosheshin shemma yishkach lelek veliroto keshettaggia shaa shishshit, sheap im yishkach alayv en kan issur, shebbevadday netaluhu haorebin qodem shehiggia shaa shishshit veholikuhu lammaqom shebbau mishsham. Veap al pi shennitbaer lemala, veyitbaer besiman tl"ch vetal"t, sheen sepeq akila motzi mide vadday chametz, mikkol maqom (ch) netilat haorebim vekayyotze bahem ugerirat hachulda vehaakbarim vekayyotze bahem hi vaddait, ella shehaakila hi sapeq, ki shemma lo hayu reebim beoto shaa, lepikak gabbe akbarim vekayyotze bahem mishshear mine chayya haggedelim babbayit, anu machamirim bevadday chametz, sheap im geraruhu hare hu tamun babbayit o bechatzer, veober alayv be"bal yimmatze", veen kan tzad hetter ella litlot shemma akaluhu, veen sapeq motzi mide vadday. Abal orebim vekayyotze bahem sheenam bene tarbut umimmaqom acher hem regilin labo lekan, im ken keshennetaluhu bevadday holikuhu lammaqom shebbau mishsham. Ella shellekattechilla en lismok al zeh keshemmaggia zeman habbiur, dehaynu techillat shaa shishshit, dekevan shehaya yakol lelek lechatzer velirot im hechametz munnach adayin sham — yelek veyirennu:
Hachorim shebbekotle hechatzer, im enan gebohim yoter midday velo nemukin yoter midday — hare hem tzerikin bediqa im derek lehishtammesh bahem, lepi shehaorebim enam metzuyim bachorim:

Chametz shennopla alayv mappolet (perush gal shel abanim veapar), im en hakkeleb yakol lehariach recho ulechappes acharayv, dehaynu sheyyesh alayv gobah g' tepachim — hare hu kimboar min haolam legamre, veeno ober alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" min hattora ap al pi shello bittelo. (T) vaapillu lekattechilla yakol lehappil alayv mappolet min hattora ap leachar shehiggia zeman habbiur ubekak hu meboar min haolam, uleachar happesach yakol lepaqqeach et haggal velachazor velizkot bechametz hattamun. Abal middibre soperim apillu im nopla alayv mappolet meelayv — tzarik lebattelo qodem shettaggia shaa shishshit, gezera shemma yitpaqqach haggal betok happesach veyitgalleh hechametz, veyaabor alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" min hattora im lo haya mebattelo qodem shaa shishshit, shemmishshaa shishshit vaelak eno yakol lebattel od, dekevan sheeno yakol od lehanot mimmennu mechamat gezerat chakamim sheasaruhu bahanaa mittechillat shaa shishshit vaelak — hare en lo shum cheleq uzekut bo, veeno niqra shello sheyyukal lebattelo ulehapqiro. Veim lo bittelah qodem shaa shishshit, yesh omerim sheap al pi sheabar al mitzvat chakamim en qonesin oto lepaqqeach et haggal lehotzi et hechametz mishsham ulebaaro min haolam. Veyesh choleqin al kol zeh veomerim, sheap shennopla alayv mappolet gaboah g' tepachim eno kimboar min haolam legamre, ella hare hu ketamun beborot shichin umearot, sheober alayv be"bal yimmatze" min hattora, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman t"m. Lepikak im eno rotzeh lepaqqeach et haggal lehotzi hechametz ulebaaro bizman habbiur — hare hu chayyab min hattora lebattelo qodem shettaggia shaa shishshit, ubebittul zeh hu yotze yede chobato ap middibre soperim, shehare iqqar gezerat chakamim sheggazeru sheen bittul vehepqer moil lechametz, enah ella kede shello yishkach veyabo leekol mimmennu bepesach im yebattelennu velo yebaarennu min haolam legamre, vechametz zeh shennopla alayv mappolet gaboah g' tepachim, sheen hakkeleb yakol lehotzio mishsham ulehannicho bemaqom megulleh — en lachosh bo shemma yabo adam leekol mimmennu bappesach, kevan shekkol yeme happesach yihyeh tamun umekusseh min haayin. Abal im lo bittelo qodem shaa shishshit — chayyab hu min hattora lepaqqeach et haggal lehotzi hechametz mishsham ulebaaro. Veim yesh chashash sakkana lepaqqeach baggal bayyadayim, kegon shehu maqom shemmetzuyim sham aqrabbim (abal nachash lo bari hezzeqa ayyen siman q"d) baashpot ubaggallim — hare hu (y) chayyab liskor poalim sheyyepaqqechu et haggal al yede mara veqardom vekayyotze bahem, beinyan sheen bo chashash sakkana ad sheyyotziu et hechametz mishsham. Uleinyan halaka, (ya) yesh lehachamir beshel tora kisbara acharona. Umikkol maqom im napal alayv gal gadol shei epshar lepaqqecho apillu al yede mara veqardom, vahare zeh hechametz abud mibbealayv umishshear kol adam — hare zeh kimboar min haolam legamre ledibre hakkol. Vaapillu lekattechilla eno tzarik lebattelo kelal, shehare omra tora "velo yeraeh leka chametz" — "shelleka" i atta roeh, vechametz zeh eno niqra "shelleka", dekevan sheeno yakol lehotzio min haggal — hare en lo shum zekut bo:

Veim napal alayv gal qatan beinyan shehakkeleb yakol lehariach recho ulechappes acharayv ulehotzio mishsham, dehaynu sheen alayv gaboah g' tepachim, ap al pi shebbittelo vehipqiro — chayyab hu lepaqqech et haggal ulebaer hechametz bizman habbiur, gezera shemma kesheyyotziennu mishsham hakkeleb leoklo yeshayyer meat meakilato veyannichennu megulleh, ukesheyyireh adam yishkach veyoklenna. Veim yesh chashash sakkana lepaqqeach baggal bayyadayim — chayyab hu lepaqqeach et haggal al yede mara veqardom beinyan sheen bo sakkana:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshebbari lo akshav bizman habbiur sheyyesh vadday chametz betok haggal, abal im lo bari lo akshav bishat habbiur sheyyesh baggal vadday chametz, kegon chorim shebbakkotel shennishtammesh bahem chametz, veachar kak napal hakkotel venaasa gal, sheyyesh lehistappeq velomar shemma kebar nittal hechametz mehachorim qodem shennapal hakkotel, velo nishtayyer mimmennu meuma behachorim, veakshav bizman habbiur en min hechametz kelum betok haggal, ulepikak, im kebar bittel et hechametz hazzeh, o sheyyakol adayin lebattelo, sheap im yesh adayin betok haggal eno chayyab lehotzio mishsham ulebaaro min hattora ella middibre soperim — lo hitrichuhu chakamim lehotzio mishsham al yede mara veqardom, kevan sheepshar sheen sham chametz kelal. Vegam lo hitzrikuhu libdoq ulechappes baggal bayyadayim velibtoach al haqqadosh baruk hu shello yazziqennu aqrab sheshsheluche mitzva enan nizzoqin (veha dechayshinan lesakkana gabbe chor shebben yisrael lenokri, hatam shekicha hezzeqa, veheka dishkicha hezzeqa lo samkinan annissa apillu kesheoseq bemitzvat hammaqom, shenneemar "vayyomer shemuel ek elek veshama shaul vaharagani, vayyomer Hashem eglat baqar tiqqach vego'". Abal haka lo shekicha hezzeqa, shemma en kan aqrab kelal baggal, veim timtza lomar yesh bo, shemma lo yigga bo beyadayv kesheyyibdoq vichappes baggal, veim timtza lomar yigga bo, shemma lo yazziqennu, ki lo yukal mechamat shehu mutman baggal, veen kan ella chashasha beolma, velo chayshinan lah ella leachar shehishlim hammitzva kemo sheyyitbaer), lepi shechashu chakamim shemma tobad lo machat begal zeh qodem bediqa zo (shebbishat habbediqa bevadday lo yobad mimmennu kelum al yede tirdato babbediqa, sheshsheluche mitzva enan nizzoqin lo begupam velo bemamonam), velo yirtzeh lechappes achareha qodem bediqa zo, lepi sheyyityare meaqrabbim hamtzuyin sham, raq bishat bediqa sheaz hu oseq bemitzva yechappes gam achar hammachat, veyesh lachosh shemma gam achar gemar habbediqa yechappes gam ken achar hammachat, veaz en oseq bemitzva kelal veyukal labo lide sakkana*[abal bishat habbediqa, apillu mechappes gam achar hammachat — have leh oseq bemitzva, kemo haomer "hare sela zo litzdaqa bishbil sheyyichyeh beni, o sheeheyeh ben olam habba", dehave tzaddiq gamur bammitzva ap shemmitkavven gam lahanaato, velo amrinan shello lishmah hu oseh, ella qiyyem mitzvat boreo shetztzivvahu laasot tzedaqa, umitkavven bah ap lahanaat atzmo sheyyichyeh beno o sheyyihyeh ben olam habba].. Abal im lo bittelo ukebar higgia shaa shishshit sheen beyado lebattelo — chayyab hu lepaqqeach (yad) al yede mara veqardom velibdoq ulechappes shemma yesh sham min hechametz shennishtammesh bachorin tok l' yom lipne happesach. Abal hechametz shennishtammesh bahem qodem l' yom yesh bo kamma sepeqot lehaqel, shemma nittal kullo mehachorim, veshemma nitappesh beorek zeman (veshemma yesh alayv gaboah g' tepachim shehu kimboar min hattora), veen tzarik lebaaro ella middibre soperim, vachakamim lo hitrichuhu lepaqqeach haggal al yede mara veqardom, kevan sheen sham chametz vadday:

Vekol zeh keshehu beinyan sheyyesh lehistappeq shemma yesh sham chametz munnach baggal veen alayv gaboah g' tepachim, abal im bari lo sheim yesh sham chametz baggal yesh alayv bevadday gaboah g' tepachim — en tzarik litroach ulepaqqeach baggal al yede mara veqardom ap al pi shennishtammesh chametz bachorim tok l' yom, dekevan sheyyesh kan sapeq shemma en min hechametz shennishtammesh bachorim kelum betok gal zeh, shekkebar nittal kullo min hachorim qodem shennapal hakkotel, lekak yesh lehaqel kehaomerim shehechametz shennopla alayv mappolet gaboah g' tepachim en tzarik lepaqqeach baggal kelal kede lebaaro ap al pi shello bittelo veen beyado lebattelo:

Chametz shennopla alayv mappolet gaboah g' tepachim ubittelo qodem shaa shishshit kemishpato, uleachar happesach nitpaqqach haggal venitgalla hechametz — hare hu muttar apillu baakila, shechametz sheabar alayv happesach eno asur ella mishshum qenas, sheqqenasuhu chakamim al sheabar be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" min hattora o middibre soperim kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"ch, vechametz zeh shennopla alayv mappolet lo abar alayv kelum — en lanu leqonso. (Veayyen besiman tl"v sheim beshaa shennopla alayv hammappolet al hechametz haya bedato lepannot haggal leachar happesach velizkot bechametz shettachtayv — hare zeh asur bahanaa, ayyen sham hattaam):

Derek otzere yayin veshemen lesadder chabiyyotehen shurot shurot ad shemmemallein kol qarqa hammartep beshurot shel chabiyyot, vechozerin umannichin chabiyyot al chabiyyot keshurot hattachtonot al pene kol orek verochab hammartep, vechozerin veosin ken kamma peamim ad shennitmalle kol hammartep chabiyyot miqqarqaito ad tiqrato al pene kol orko (perush, min hakkotel shebbo patuach happetach vead hakkotel shekkenegdo niqra orek, umin hakkotel shebbetzad zeh vead hakkotel shebbetzad zeh niqra rochab) veal pene kol rochbo, keshehu ba lebodqo mechametz (ukegon shedderek lehistappeq mimmennu, shehu tzarik bediqa kemo shennitbaer lemala) — en tzarik libdoq bekullo, ella bodeq ben hechabiyyot shebbishte shurot haelyonot hassemukot lakkotel shebbo happetach, dehaynu shura achat al pene kol rochab hammartep mehakkotel shebbetzad happetach ad hakkotel shekkenegdah, vehu orek shura zo, verochbah hu orek chabit achat, veshura zo hi semuka lakkotel shebbo happetach, vehi elyona al gabbe kol hashshurot hassemukot lekotel zo, veod bodeq bashshura shettachat shura zo vedayyo, shebbishte ellu shurot ragil hashshammash lehanniach pitto beshaa shemmozeg yayin min hechabiyyot:

Batte kenesiyyot ubatte midrashot tzerikin bediqa belel y"d leor hanner, mippene shehattinoqot maknisin bahen chametz kol hashshana. Vehashshammashim enam nizharim libdoq ballayla ella mekabbedin heteb bayyom, velo yapeh hem osim, vetzarik lehazhiram al kak sheyyeqayyemu mitzvat chakamenu ketiqqunah (vikolin lebarek al bediqa zo). Abal en tzerikim lebattel achar habbediqa, lepi sheen yekolim lebattel ulehapqir chametz sheeno shellahem, sheen adam mapqir dabar sheeno shello:

Im abar velo badaq batte kenesiyyot ubatte midrashot belel y"d — yakol lebodqam lekattechilla beyom y"d leor hayyom, veen tzarik libdoq leor hanner, lepi shedderek leharbot bahem challonot veyesh bahem ora gedola, vahare dinam kedin aksadra shennitbaer lemala. Veken shear battim vachadarim sheyyesh bahem challonot harbeh veora gedola dinam keaksadra:

Kol cheder hatztzarik bediqa, tzarik lekabbedo qodem habbediqa, lepi sheqqodem hakkibbud yesh aprurit harbeh veeno yakol libdoq yapeh. Veyazhir kol adam et bene beto sheyyekabbedu gam tachat hammittot, shemma nitgalgel lesham meat chametz:

Veachar shekkibbedu heteb bekol hammeqomot, tzarik hu lachazor velibdoq bekol hammeqomot leor hanner bachorim ubassedaqim hatztzerikin bediqa, shemma yesh sham meat chametz, shehakkibbud eno moil kelum lemah shebbachorim usedaqim:
Vaapillu tachat hammittot tzarik hu libdoq leor hanner achar hakkibbud, ella im ken tarnegolim metzuyin sham, sheaz yesh litlot shehem akelu kol hechametz shennitgalgel tachat hammittot:

Abal tachat hassapsalim tzarik libdoq leor hanner ap im metzuyin sham tarnegolim, lepi shei epshar shello napal lesham chametz im hu cheder sheokelin bo, vahare yesh kan chametz vadday tachat hassapsalim, veen sepeq akilat hattarnegolin motzia mide vadday chametz:

Veyizzaher kol adam libdoq ulenaer habbatte yadayim vehakkisim shel habbegadim shello veshel hattinoqot, lepi shellipamim maknisin bahen chametz. Veen tzarik lebodqan belel y"d, shehare lemachar kesheyyokal chametz epshar sheyyachazor veyaknis bahen chametz, umah hoil bibdiqato? Ella yibdeqem vinaarem lemachar bishat habbiur. Veap im rotzeh lehachamir al atzmo ulebodqam belel y"d — tzarik lachazor ulebodqam lemachar bishat habbiur, shemma chazar vehiknis bahem mechametz sheakal achar habbediqa:

Vekol zeh bemi sheddarko lipamim litten chametz letok habbatte yadayim vehakkisim shel habbegadim, abal mi shelleolam en darko bekak — en tzarik bediqa kelal lo belel y"d velo bishat habbiur. Umikkol maqom hammachamir tabo alayv beraka.
